theme: The Obsidian Lab - Dark, cinematic, organic meets digital. A premium, high-tech biotechnology aesthetic prioritizing negative space, sharp contrasts, and laboratory-grade precision.

accents.primary_description: Fluorescent Lime (CRISPR Green) - Use strictly for critical data, small high-tech UI lines, or primary CTA hover states. Do NOT use as a large background.
accents.secondary_description: Bioluminescence Cyan - Use for subtle 3D lighting or deep background glows.

typography.import_commands: Ensure to add @fontsource/syne, @fontsource/manrope, and @fontsource/space-mono or import from Google Fonts in index.css

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Optical Clarity' Glassmorphism only for the fixed header (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). All other cards should be flat, brutalist rectangles (bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/5) with NO border-radius (rounded-none).
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-white/10) to create a 'technical grid' feel across sections.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle absolute full-screen noise/grain SVG overlay with pointer-events-none and opacity-20 to kill the digital flatness.

sections_blueprint.name: Navigation
sections_blueprint.layout: Fixed top, z-50, glassmorphism. Left: Logo (Syne font, bold). Right: Mono-font links + minimal CTA button.
sections_blueprint.interactions: Links hover change to Fluorescent Lime.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero Section (Kinetic)
sections_blueprint.layout: h-screen relative flex items-center overflow-hidden. Text container z-10 w-full px-8 md:px-24. 3D Canvas absolute inset-0 z-0.
sections_blueprint.content: Massive H1 split into multiple lines. Overline mono text above H1.
sections_blueprint.interactions: SIGNATURE ON-LOAD: Use Framer Motion for a line-by-line masked text reveal. y: 100 to y: 0 with clipPath. 3D element slow rotation.
sections_blueprint.3d_element: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei to render a slow-rotating particle sphere or abstract biological mesh (representing a cell/molecule). If complex, use a fallback layered parallax.

sections_blueprint.name: About / The Manifesto
sections_blueprint.layout: Massive vertical padding (py-32). Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Left side (col-span-4): Numbered chapters in Space Mono (e.g., '01 / ORIGIN'). Right side (col-span-8): Large Syne text revealing concept.
sections_blueprint.interactions: Scroll-triggered text color fill or Framer Motion whileInView line-up reveals.

sections_blueprint.name: Technology (Tetris Bento Grid)
sections_blueprint.layout: py-24 px-8 md:px-24. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Create severe asymmetry. 1 hero block (col-span-8, row-span-2), 2 smaller technical blocks (col-span-4).
sections_blueprint.styling: Cards are dark, sharp-edged. Inside hero block: Place the abstract liquid macro image with an overlay.

sections_blueprint.name: Editorial Marquee
sections_blueprint.interactions: Use react-fast-marquee. Massive text (text-7xl), outline only (text-transparent stroke-white style, or webkit-text-stroke). Words: 'GENOMIC EDITING — SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY — CELLULAR REPROGRAMMING —'.

sections_blueprint.name: Statistics / Impact
sections_blueprint.layout: Grid of 3 to 4 massive numbers. text-7xl font-mono text-[#D4FF00].
sections_blueprint.interactions: Framer Motion count-up effect on scroll into view.

sections_blueprint.name: Final CTA
sections_blueprint.layout: py-32 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center border-t border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent to-[#D4FF00]/5.
sections_blueprint.styling: Massive heading. Button: Pill-shaped, bg-[#D4FF00] text-black hover:scale-105 transition-transform, glowing shadow.

hero_fallback_or_texture.description: Abstract blue/black fluid art. Use as a blended background texture (opacity-30 mix-blend-screen) if 3D is not fully covering the hero.

manifesto_scientist.description: Portrait of scientist in dark lab. Use in the About/Manifesto section, placed in a clipped, sharp asymmetrical frame (e.g., aspect-[3/4] w-72).

technology_macro.description: Microscope lens macro shot. Use inside the primary Bento Grid block as a background image with a dark gradient overlay (bg-black/60).

motion_and_animations.smooth_scroll: Wrap the app in Lenis for premium momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for an Awwwards feel.
motion_and_animations.micro_interactions: All buttons must have scale/transform transitions. Use hover:bg-[#D4FF00] hover:text-black for primary interactive elements.
motion_and_animations.scroll_reveals: Do NOT fade in whole sections at once. Use staggered Framer Motion variants. Elements should slide up slightly (y: 30 to y: 0) while fading in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #050505 background. Muted text must be at least #8B949E to pass APCA/WCAG on black.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query to disable Lenis and Framer Motion for sensitive users.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, navigation links, and major section wrappers for testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break this. Do not build standard Vercel-like SaaS cards for this. It is a premium, cinematic biotech site.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn for layout. Build custom raw HTML/Tailwind HTML structures with Framer Motion.
Do NOT use border-radius for cards. Use sharp edges (rounded-none) to convey scientific precision.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Sections should have py-24 or py-32.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling inside a custom hook or component and wrap the app.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or dummy image URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background in header. Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur with solid color opacity).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
